usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the current Ceph cluster health, monitor status, OSD map, and pool statistics from any node that is a member of the cluster. The response is cluster-wide (equivalent to `ceph status`), so any healthy, online Ceph node can be used as the target — choose a node that is reachable and actively participating in the cluster. Requires either Sys.Audit or Datastore.Audit on the root path; API tokens are supported.

examples.summary: Check Ceph cluster health from node pve1

tips: Since the response is cluster-wide, any active Ceph member node returns the same data — pick the node closest to your API endpoint or the one you know is online.
Look at response fields health.status ('HEALTH_OK', 'HEALTH_WARN', 'HEALTH_ERR') and health.checks for actionable degradation details.
If Ceph is not configured on the cluster this endpoint returns an error; use GET /nodes/{node}/ceph/config or check for Ceph installation before calling.
For a cluster-scoped alias that does not require specifying a node, use GET /cluster/ceph/status instead.
